map.楼板、次梁按简支估算跨中弯矩 Mmax=wL²/8 与剪力 Vmax=wL/2，: For floor slabs and secondary beams, take the mid-span moment Mmax = wL²/8 and shear Vmax = wL/2 as the governing forces for reinforcement and connection design.

map.均布荷载与点荷载结果差多少？: How much do UDL and point load results differ?
map.同总荷载下，跨中弯矩点荷（PL/4）约为均布（wL²/8=PL/8）的 2 倍，: For the same total load the mid-span moment from a central point load (PL/4) is about twice that of a UDL (wL²/8 = PL/8). Load form therefore directly affects reinforcement and the two must not be mixed.
map.挠度超限怎么调？: What if the deflection exceeds the limit?
map.增大截面高度 h（挠度∝1/h³ 量级）、提高刚度 EI 或减小跨度；也可加反拱: Increase the section depth h (deflection scales roughly as 1/h³), raise the stiffness EI, or shorten the span. You can also add a camber or switch to a continuous beam to reduce the mid-span moment.
map.连续梁能按简支估算吗？: Can a continuous beam be estimated as simply supported?
map.不能。连续梁支座负弯矩显著大于简支跨中弯矩，简支结果会低估支座区配筋，需按连续梁: No. Support negative moments in a continuous beam are significantly larger than the mid-span moment of a simply supported beam, so a simply supported estimate understates support reinforcement. Use continuous-beam coefficients or a finite element check.
map.截面惯性矩 I (cm⁴，按 b×h 自动计算): Section moment of inertia I (cm⁴, computed from b×h)
map.简支梁均布荷载：最大弯矩 M = qL² ÷ 8（kN·m）、最大剪力 V =: Simply supported beam under UDL: max moment M = qL²/8 (kN·m), max shear V = qL/2 (kN), mid-span deflection δ = 5qL⁴/384EI (q converted from kN/m to N/m, E from GPa×1e9 to Pa; I = bh³/12 from b×h, converted from cm⁴ by ×1e-8 to m⁴, result ×1000 to mm); section modulus W = bh²/6 (mm³), bending stress σ = M×1e6/W (MPa, M from kN·m to N·mm). Validation: L, E, b, h > 0 and q ≥ 0, otherwise show 'enter valid beam parameters'. Note: I is read-only and uses the same section as the stress check, avoiding two conflicting section definitions. Serviceability limit state stiffness (GB 50010-2010 7.2.3/7.2.5): h₀ = h − a_s (a_s is the distance from the tension edge to the centroid of tension reinforcement, not the cover c); M_k = q_k·L²/8 (characteristic combination), M_q = q_q·L²/8 (quasi-permanent combination); ρ = A_s/(b·h₀), ρ_te = A_s/(0.5·b·h) (take 0.01 if below), α_E = E_s/E_c (E_s = 2×10⁵ MPa); σ_s = M_k/(0.87·h₀·A_s); ψ = 1.1 − 0.65·f_tk/(ρ_te·σ_s) (clamped to 0.2–1.0); B_s = E_s·A_s·h₀²/[1.15ψ + 0.2 + 6α_Eρ/(1+3.5γ_f')]; B = M_k/[M_q(θ−1)+M_k]·B_s (θ defaults to 2.0 and applies only when long-term load effects dominate; adjust per the code for non-standard cases); δ_lt = 5·M_k·L²/(48·B); limits by effective span l₀ (l₀/200 for l₀<7 m, l₀/250 for 7 m≤l₀≤9 m, l₀/300 for l₀>9 m, GB 50010-2010 Table 3.4.3), δ_lt ≤ limit is satisfied (equality counts as satisfied). Combination convention: σ_s and ψ use the characteristic combination M_k; long-term stiffness reduction and deflection checks use the quasi-permanent combination M_q.

map.受压翼缘系数 γ_f'（矩形取 0）: Compression flange factor γ_f' (0 for rectangular sections)
map.计算跨度 l₀ (m，用于挠度限值): Effective span l₀ (m, used for the deflection limit)
map.挠度验算 δ_lt / 限值 (mm，l₀ 分档): Deflection check δ_lt / limit (mm, graded by l₀)
map.h₀ = h − a_s；a_s 为受拉钢筋合力点至受拉边缘距离（单排常取 35: h₀ = h − a_s; a_s is the distance from the tension edge to the centroid of tension reinforcement (typically 35 for a single layer and 60 for two layers), not the cover thickness c
map.强度等级 C25–C40 联动 f_tk 与 E_c，可手动覆盖；手动值与等级不: Strength grades C25–C40 link f_tk and E_c and can be overridden; if the manual values do not match the grade, the page warns against mixing, e.g. C25 strength with C40 stiffness
map.荷载口径：q_k 为标准组合、q_q 为准永久组合；页内推 M_k = q_kL: Load convention: q_k is the characteristic combination and q_q the quasi-permanent combination; the page derives M_k = q_kL²/8 and M_q = q_qL²/8
map.组合口径：σ_s 与 ψ 用标准组合 M_k；长期刚度折减与挠度验算用准永久组合: Combination convention: σ_s and ψ use the characteristic combination M_k; the long-term stiffness reduction and deflection check use the quasi-permanent combination M_q
map.θ 默认 2.0（GB 50010-2010 7.2.5，仅长期荷载效应为主时适: θ defaults to 2.0 (GB 50010-2010 7.2.5, only when long-term load effects dominate); it is not a constant and must be adjusted for non-standard cases
map.挠度限值按计算跨度 l₀ 分档（表 3.4.3）：l₀<7m → l₀/200、: Deflection limits are graded by effective span l₀ (Table 3.4.3): l₀/200 for l₀<7 m, l₀/250 for 7 m≤l₀≤9 m, l₀/300 for l₀>9 m; δ_lt ≤ limit is satisfied, and equality counts as satisfied
map.单排 35、双排 60: 35 for a single layer, 60 for two layers
